Name: Manasseh
Summary: Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn son by Asenath, born in Egypt before the famine.
KeyStory: Joseph named him Manasseh, saying God had made him forget all his toil and his father's house — yet Jacob later blessed Ephraim above him.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Asenath; Ephraim
LifeLesson: God's blessing does not always follow birth order — He chooses as He wills.
